item.title: Version 1.5.4
item.changes: Fixes a crash when inverting an AI restore mask. Destructive natural-language actions (delete layer, remove mask, ungroup, crop canvas) now always ask for confirmation. Privacy Mode is honored by the connection test; the test no longer leaks a network session per click. The gateway requires a full http(s) base URL, no longer doubles the /v1 prefix, and won't leave a duplicate channel when the key write fails. Smart Arrange keeps the canvas responsive on large documents and can't be re-triggered mid-scan. Signed with Developer ID, hardened runtime, notarized and stapled.
